Why Pinterest Keywords Matter?

Pinterest is a visual search engine, not a social media platform. To get your designs and videos discovered, you need to use the right language that users are searching for. Our curated lists are updated based on current trends specifically within the creative niche.

By implementing these keywords in your Pin titles, descriptions, and alt-text, you increase the likelihood of your assets being indexed and recommended to potential clients and followers.
